info.title: Origin Trace local HTTP API
info.description: Source-backed description of the Origin Trace Rust backend HTTP interface. Not a new server or a promise of full native-app parity. No credential authentication is implemented. Every /api/ request and every POST requires Host to name localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1 with the exact listening port; cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site is rejected. If Origin is present it must be HTTP, local, same port, without credentials/query/fragment. Nonbrowser CLI clients can omit Origin. Use local access only. Schemas explicitly marked partial retain source-specific gaps; x-max-utf8-bytes is documentary, not a standard JSON Schema validator keyword.

No interception request may be running and Object Lab must not be navigating/searching/mutating. Active Repeater permits only cancel_repeater_request. Runtime Hooks arming/armed/handling/stopping permits only disarm_runtime_hooks, including blocking compare_runtime_field_test.

The action lock must be idle except for stop_memory_origin_trace, disarm_runtime_hooks, cancel_repeater_request, cancel_automation_recipe, and disarm_automation_recipes. Exemption from this lock does not bypass other ownership guards.

RepeaterBodyDiff.description: Optional v1 comparison extension. Deterministic line alignment of retained UTF-8 text, capped at 1000 input lines per body, 200 output rows, 32768 total UTF-8 text bytes and 4096 bytes per row. Exact equality bypasses alignment. Line totals cover retained bodies; change counts cover inspected prefixes, not omitted capture. Source terminators participate in equality; text excludes LF/CRLF. Source numbers increase per side; context has both, added has null baseline, removed has null current. partial equals a nonempty limits_reached. Rows include two nearby edit records of context; line-number gaps identify omitted context. Raw bodies and digests remain unchanged.
